name: Code
description: Inline code for a function name, prop, file path or CLI flag inside prose.

ariaRequirements: none: static text with code semantics
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-25: built from the Figma component (Astryx Code/CodeBlock and Geist code/code-block/snippet benchmarks) to replace CodeBlockWindow and CodeSnippet.

forbiddenUse: Use for a multi-line block or a command meant to be copied; use CodeBlock or Snippet.
dense: inline <code> chip on the light surface; sm/md/lg match the surrounding text size

usage.description: Code marks a short literal inside running text. Match its size to the text around it: sm beside Body xxs and xs, md beside s and m, lg beside l.

bestPractices.description: Use for identifiers, props, file paths, environment variables and CLI flags inside a sentence.
Keep it to a few words; a line of code belongs in Snippet or CodeBlock.
Do not add a copy button or make it a link target; it is static text.
Do not use for keyboard keys; that is Kbd.

size.description:
Match the surrounding text: `sm` beside Body xxs/xs, `md` beside s/m,
`lg` beside l.
